description: Live-data scenario: starts from a dry baseline (no fixed rainfall, no fixed values) and is driven at runtime by REST polling of the 12 community river gauges via startGaugePoll (tsm-console/src/lib/river-gauges.ts) — NO websockets, NO EventSource, NO MQTT anywhere in the path. The operator maps the freshest live gauge stage to a rainfall/intensity override through the workbench datum gate (wseFromGageHeight): without a validated NAVD88 gage zero the readout is 'SOURCE DATUM ONLY'. Missing gauge data is never interpolated; gauge status is LIVE / STALE / SOURCE UNAVAILABLE. All rainfall values in this mode are operator-supplied at runtime and therefore provisional by construction.
provisionalFields: engine rainfall (operator-supplied at runtime from live gauge polling; no fixed values in this file)
operator stage→intensity mapping (judgment call, not a calibrated rating)
all depth / damage outputs (computed, not observed)
source: operator-supplied at runtime; gauge definitions from tsm-console/src/lib/river-gauges.ts COMMUNITY_RIVER_GAUGES (12 stations) and artifacts/tsm-river-valley-realtime-stations-v1.json. Polling only — startGaugePoll REST, 60 s default.
title: Live gauge-driven (poll-fed, no fixed values)
